mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' normalized Even Better Sinewave crossing zero on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a denoised cycle phase transition; follow the new phase direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long on a strict nonpositive-to-positive normalized wave crossing; short on a strict nonnegative-to-negative crossing
mechanism.why_distinct: A one-pole duration-40 high-pass removes trend, a period-10 two-pole Super Smoother removes aliasing noise, and a three-bar wave is normalized by contemporaneous power. It is not the two-pole Roofing Filter, a price-average crossover, bounded price/range oscillator, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: power-normalized denoised cycle phase crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.filtered: period-10 two-pole Super Smoother of current and prior HP
features.wave: mean current and prior two filtered values
features.power: mean squared current and prior two filtered values
features.initialization: after a gap first HP and first two filtered observations are zero; require 40 uninterrupted observations before source validity
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Ehlers duration-40 normalized Even Better Sinewave zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no duration, smoother, normalization, initialization, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, Even Better Sinewave Indicator, Cycle Analytics for Traders
external_basis.fixed_definition: close input; Duration=40 one-pole high-pass; period-10 Super Smoother; Wave=three-bar mean of filtered values; Pwr=three-bar mean square; normalized Wave/sqrt(Pwr); zero line
external_basis.selection_use: published defaults, recursions, normalization, and zero reference only; no incidence or outcomes
